solution.text:
For a second order reaction, A+B→P, if [A]0≠[B]0 then the integrated rate law equation will be

kt=1[A]0-[B]0ln⁡[A][B]0[B][A]0

where, k= rate constant, t= time

If [A]0=[B]0 then for second order reaction, A+A→P, integrated rate law equation will be

1[A]=1[A]0+kt or 1[B]=1[B]0+kt
